{{Top|leg}}
A '''Vocal analyzer''' was a piece of technology that could scan an individual or [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] speech and compare it to previous samples in order to find differences. [[I-5YQ]] could imitate voices to the point where a vocal analyzer could not detect the difference.<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
